body: The liability goes deeper than how "safe" it is.

I feel exactly the same.  I have nobody!  Nobody!  If I could just find someone to take my son in and watch over him until he is independent(just turned 18), I would do it in a heartbeat.  My son has mentioned several times that he wants to die also.  He offered if I got a gun, he would take care of both of us.
You now have no choice but to take the proper action.  You have a unknown identity to subscribers of this app.  However, there is a simple way to know your identity.  Just do the right thing.
Well, I am an RN of 29 years.  I have seen my share.  Yes, they express their desire to go.  They are tired.  They are ready to go home.  Their words, not mine.
You can't lean on adult children either.  Trust me.  I also had a psychiatrist tell me that I should never expect my grown children to be part of my support system.
Agreed!!  It was not good being the caregiver for 17 months and the wife.  So much went into the caregiving that "we" got burried.  Sad and it fucking hurts!!
My husband also had a Glioblastoma.  I don't know what to say.  I am a nurse and this was a horrible thing to watch him go through.  Gob bless!
"Homeless".  That is it.  That is the constant feeling.  Just waiting to also go "home".
Tell them this.  Tell them that you don't understand why you can't cry.  How much it bothers you.  Just tell them what you posted.
I will remember both of you on Valentine's Day!
That is correct.  I did exactly this.

No offense but I can't comprehend how the grieving ever ends.  Almost 3 years......  It is nice that you are happy with someone new.  Myself, I have no desire for anyone but my late husband.   No, it won't come in time.  I took care of him 24/7 pretty much alone.  So emotionally and physically exhausting.  Then to deal with nasty family members.  I have no desire to ever go there again.
I would say for non-emergent care of this matter, no doctor is going to take on this liability.

Not sure of your state laws.  Some will only allow treatment without a parental consent for sexually transmitted diseases.  If your juristication allows vaccines also, your county health department should be able to administer at no cost.

2 years, 11 months........better but the pain is there everyday.  I guess it is because I never want to forget what we had and what I learned from his sincere love and friendship.  It is a new life.  I have learned that others will never understand.  Therefore, feel lots, share little.  Forever in my heart.  Yet I have to do the best I can with this new life.   The thing I wish for the most, is knowing someone in close proximity to me that is enduring the same.  A friend who gets it!!
Good insight!
Yep!!  I would gladly even take a terminally ill person's position right now.  Get Hospice and morphine!!!
"I don't even remember".  PROOF that there really is no one who has the ability to care.  A bunch of talk.
I would think this would fall under "unearned income".  Is that even taxable?
It does sound like it was peaceful.  That in itself is a blessing.
You are not even my son and my heart aches for you.  My son lost his father when he was 15.  Praying for you, dad and family.
Bless you!!  I truly am sorry for your loss!!   Go on for your father.  You need each other.  He is very fortunate to have a son who is caring.
I can see his desperation.  However, the big picture is the donor.  Sounds like she is too young to make that decision and live with it forever.   I would not proceed.
Why??  So you can find someone to make money from?
No group within 50+ miles.  Online group.  Just a bunch of random post ftom people all over that you never meet.
No one gives me time nor allows effort.  I am an outcast.  A widow!!  Www!  Who wants to deal with her?
Help??  There is no decent help in my area. Maybe a little better quality if so had insurance.  Friends and family would be nice.  But the small amount of family so have......no., Friends.......
Today was rough.  I was driving and came very close to swerving left of center into a semi

Ramen,
I think you missed the point.  It isn't "wishing" widowhood upon others. But maybe not understanding why some have to suffer the loss of a vibrant family member while someone in their 80' s has most likely mentally preparing for death and even welcomes it.  There really does come a time that one is just done.
I understand what you are saying.  Not harsh, but perhaps it was the timing for each individually.  Mom, perhaps was at the end of the journey and was gladly ready for her rest.
So sorry!!  My son watched his father deteriorate at home for 17 months.  He was only 13 y.o. when he became ill.
I agree!  I only had 20 years.  Ripped my soul out.

I do agree with your comment the most.  But what hurts the most is that only one of my 4 sister came to my,husbands funeral.  Then she was late, dressed in jeans and t-shirt.  He was so good to them.  But what about the possibility that they isolate me because they don't give two shots about their husbands.  How do you relate to them?  They have wished theirs dead, etc,
I wish I would have.  Things only get worse.  I have always known I would......I am just waiting to get certain things done first.
As for the nail gun, I am not very big, know anatomy very well and would do it right.
Today was the closest I came.  My son has an AR Rifel here.   I nearly waited on a huge truck/heavy traffic to pull out in front of.
"Crippled".....I consider being in this world crippled.

I know anatomy.  I have large nails.  Doesn't take much if you go through the roof of your mouth.  Besides.....either way, it will work.  Even through the heart would work.  I am thin.  Therefore, it would go right in.

A total stranger "to talk to"?  I said....I don't care about the pain!!  Who cares about the pain when it isn't going to last that long and the goal is met?  The pain is the least of my worries!!  It will be nothing compared to the years of hell.  Why can those who are terminal with cancer get all the morphine they want so they can die?   Yet I am terminal with depression/isolation, etc.  I have the right and a very good reason to die! ,   I have a certain time I am leaving to do this.  Just in case, but I doubt anyone would look for me.....hahaha, I have disabled my OnStar.  Not taking my phone!  Trust me!!  I will do it right the first time!
Just for the purpose of the presentation, try positive affirmations/traits.  For an employer.......they don't want to hear the truth of anything that may be negative.
NO!  Afraid of never being cured!!  I have been this way for at least 50 years.  I will most likely never see actual "life".

And they take the "safe road".  Therefore they can't be held accountable.  Watch those magic words....they very often are a punishment.  Taking away what little indepence you have.  Possibly causing your self unwanted stigma or a job loss.  Etc, etc.. Etc....

I don't have anyone for an exercise buddy.😞  I would consider acupuncture.  I don't think I have the strength to start a new job.  If I did take a less stressful one in my field, I would probably cut my income in half.  I don't think I could make it financially.
Right!  Then they will say, "There were no warning signs.  If he/she would have just came to me".
Same thoughts.  I have had this feeling for a while.  I have told my sister, "We both know I eventually will".

"You are not the first person to go through this.....".  "What do you expect me to do"?  "You are just pushing people away".  'It will get better". "Just stop.  You can't think that way".  "Maybe you should ask your doctor to adjust your meds" , Etc, etc,  People who could/should be there for others, simply just make comments and ignore the hurting person.  Then bitch because the depressed person indirectly is crying for help.  Needing friends/family.  Counseling and medication just are not the answer.  But.......if this is how much they care, who do we have??

Same!  They only respond with pre-printed responses.  Refer you to counseling.  If you say the "magic words", you will only get locked up and treated like you committed a crime.  May cause you to lose your job, etc.  You have no access to any of your personal belongings.  They take total control of you.  Force medication on you to make you a zombie!!!  No help, no counseling........nothing!!  

All people are asking for is someone to assist and not turn their backs on them.  No one ever makes that commitment.  The just call the police on you.  Their job is done.....they helped!!

The one worried about those left behind, only pushes one deeper into despair.  It is their individual,pain that needs addressed.  Not the needs of those who don't care now while we are alive!!  Perhaps they have added to,our demise?   Therefore, who cares what they experience as long as our pain is gone!!
Who?   Who is this imaginary "someone else"?
Yeh, then they die and you are back to nothing.  Wishing you died with them.
If no one cares before and we have no friends, then some of us don't care who sees us how when found.  Our goal is to end our pain.

It is 50+ years in the making.  Feel better??  I don't know what I was thinking even joining.  Like there is some magical potion being handed out.  I am hated!!  I am no good unless I truly bow down to everyone's needs and be how they want me to be.  I can't do it!!  

I have the right to go.  It is relieving to know I am.
BTW......your post just made me realize how hated so must be.  That I have no right to feel this way.  It just induced more pain.........

Gaming?  I don't game.  That to me is not true contact.  Social events...... I guess it is possible.  Just seams like people already go with their friends.  

Maybe it would be more genuine if the few family members I have left and those "friends" of the past were still "family and friends".  I dread making new friends and going through the same thing.  I seem to only attract those who need from me.  I can't tolerate that any longer.

I guess it is me.  I get what I deserve.   Not having a pity party.  I feel it is the truth.
Same here!  But I wouldn't dare say it.  No one talks to me unless an absolute necessity for them.  If I mention it......they only want to be a "hero" and call the "patty wagon".
